title: routing: newsgroup name not sanitized before header injection
description: add_newsgroups_header prepends 'Newsgroups: {newsgroup}\r\n' without validating the newsgroup name for CR/LF characters. An attacker-controlled newsgroup name containing \r\n can inject arbitrary RFC 5322 headers into the article. The newsgroup name should be validated to contain only RFC 3977-legal characters (alphanumeric, dot, hyphen) before embedding it in the header.
